Kudos to Fiery Trippers Team for arranging a perfectly planned 5 nights 6 days Dubai trip for us 💯

- Airport pick-up and drops - perfectly scheduled with no delays

- Day 1 (Marina Cruise) : Amazing experience 😁... We had welcome drinks, prearranged tables, amazing staff, great services, nicely arranged buffet dinner, famous Tanura dance show, great sight seeing (Dubai Eye and iconic buildings).

- Day 2 (Half day Dubai City tour and Desert Safari) : First half of the day was the City tour which was well organized and planned - We saw Dubai Mall, Burj Al Arab, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Frame, Museum of future, Atlantis and did stop for photos at multiple places. Second half of the day was Desert Safari. We absolutely enjoyed the Desert Safari experience - Picked up in 4X4 vehicle, thrilling dune bashing session, Camel Ride, Horse Ride, Eagle Photography, Arabic dress photoshoot, Mehendi Art, Tanura dance, Jaw dropping Fire show and yummy buffet

- Day 3 (Abu Dhabi city tour with Ferrari World) : We were picked up in the morning and we covered our journey from Dubai to Abu Dhabi. In Abu Dhabi we saw Grand Mosque, Visit to Dates market, Corniche beach, Emirates palace and Ethihad tower. Later we were dropped at Ferrari World which was an amazing experience. We rode the world's fastest roller coaster, experienced more amazing rides and clicked a lot of photos with Ferrari Cars ... It was a once in a life experience 🤩🤩

- Day 4 (Miracle Garden and Global Village) : We were picked up post lunch and were taken to Miracle Garden. We enjoyed it to the fullest and were mesmerized by the way they have constructed the Garden. It hold 3 world records and has everything to WOW your experience 😃😃. Later we were taken to Global Village - ohh my my - What a place to visit 😁😁. The view before and after sunset with make your heart go "AWESOME!!!". It has segments from all countries around the world with flavours of their culture and food. We were lost in its beauty and enjoyed to our fullest.

- Day 5 ( Burj Khalifa and Fish Aquarium) : We were picked at 4 pm and taken to Dubai Mall. The mall is so big that you need a few days to explore it 😜. We first visited Aquarium and enjoyed entering the underwater segment, where we were surrounded by different fishes including SHARKS 🦈 - we loved it! We then relished our tastebuds at "The Cheesecake Factory" - Ambiance and Food and Cheesecake and service was Perfect n Yummy 😁. We then visited the 124th floor of Burj Khalifa and the view of Dubai City amazed us 🤩🤩. We then came down and enjoyed the Dubai Mall fountain show and Dubai Mall Waterfall before ending our Day 5 iteanirary.

- Day 6 : It was a day at leasure, where we walked to Meena Bazar and Gold Souk (around the corner from our Hotel)

The hotel booked for us "Hotel Omega" is an amazing hotel to be, in terms of their location, services, cozy and classy rooms, amenities like Swimming Pool, Gym, Souna, SPA (paid) and off course the yummy breakfast buffet (which was included in the package)

The whole experience was amazing and we will recommend Fiery Trippers to everyone visiting Dubai - Excellent Trip Organizers!
